name: je-class2-contributions
description: Jersey Class 2 social contributions for 2026, covering classification, statutory income inputs, low-income exceptions, reduced-rate branches, startup concessions and reconciliation. Use for Jersey self-employed contributions, Class 2 notices, prior-year income, low earnings or startup contributions. Includes conditional annual arithmetic, application timing, payment duties and the trading-profit deduction. Requires established insured status, applicable relief and classified income before calculation. Raw turnover, tax profit or salary alone is insufficient. Final penny rounding, benefit assessment and disputed classifications require official evidence. This source-cited draft awaits professional review and produces working papers for review before filing or payment.
